Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 23
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator computed the result using rough assumptions (50/50 gender split of the total 2011 population and applying 21.5% and 29.3% to those halves) instead of using the actual 2011 Bulgarian census counts by gender. This misapplication of percentages to an incorrect base led to an overestimated difference (287.8k) rather than the correct census-based difference of 234.9k.
